text: Four LEGO minifigures walk in a line across a zebra crossing, recreating the iconic Abbey Road album cover. From left to right: a white Stormtrooper, a black Darth Vader figure, another white Stormtrooper, and a white bunny-costumed figure. They stride left to right against a black background, rendered in iridescent rainbow-gradient coloring. The camera slowly orbits clockwise around the group, transitioning from a front-facing view to a side angle, gradually revealing the figures from increasingly behind, while they maintain their walking poses throughout.
